title: A Prom for the Mixtape
premise: Petra Sterling, a debate champion trapped in a house where his father's word is law, discovers a group chat called 'The Mixtape' that predicts school events before they happen — and its latest prediction names him as the next casualty of an accident that hasn't occurred yet. As he investigates the chat's anonymous admins, he realizes they're using foreknowledge to manipulate the school's social hierarchy, and the girl he loves is their next target. Petra must choose between winning the state championship his father demands and exposing the Mixtape before prom night, when the final prediction comes due. He loses the championship on purpose, breaks the prediction by saving her, and finally wins the argument at home by walking out.
about_author: Casper Joubert is the pen name of a former high-school debater who spent one unforgettable senior year in a small town where everyone knew everyone's business. They write stories about teenagers who discover that the hardest arguments are never won at a podium.

chapters.title: Track One: Static
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. Days before the state championship, Petra endures his father's scripted practice sessions and rehearses the rebuttal he'll never say aloud. At school, he's added to a group chat he never joined, where someone posts tomorrow's fire drill — hours early. When it happens exactly as posted, Petra screenshots it, and the chat goes silent. The emotional beat: restless dread, the first crack in a predictable life.

chapters.title: Track Two: B-Side
chapters.summary: Petra's POV, with interludes from the chat's messages. The predictions escalate: a breakup, a stolen test, a teacher's resignation — all accurate. Petra teams up with Wren Okafor, the debate rival who received the second-to-last prediction naming her. Their investigation points toward three possible admins, including Petra's best friend. Meanwhile his father schedules extra coaching, tightening the leash. Emotional beat: wary alliance blooming into something neither will name.

chapters.title: Track Three: Skip
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. The final prediction drops: 'Prom night. The gym. One of you doesn't walk out.' Petra confronts his best friend, who confesses the chat began as a joke with borrowed gossip but was hijacked by someone using it to control people — and that person wants Wren punished for refusing them. Petra's father forbids anything that risks the championship. Emotional beat: betrayal, then resolve; love declared against duty.

chapters.title: Track Four: Last Song
chapters.summary: Petra's POV. At states, Petra throws the final round with a concession speech that exposes the blackmailer's identity over the livestream, sacrificing the trophy his father worships. Racing to prom, he reaches the gym as the trap closes on Wren and dismantles it publicly. The prediction breaks; the chat dies. His father's fury meets Petra's quiet exit plan. Emotional beat: catharsis — losing the argument that didn't matter to win the one that did.
